prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game character sprite sheet for 36×42 pixel animation frames
Primary request: Generate one transparent sprite sheet for the NEW Nhinh character facing straight up (away from the viewer). Arrange exactly 7 distinct poses in a clean 4-column × 2-row grid: top row = idle, walk 0, walk 1, walk 2; bottom row = run 0, run 1, run 2, with the last bottom-right cell completely empty and transparent. Each cell should contain one centered full-body sprite, same scale and consistent feet baseline.
Input images: Image 1 is the current Nhinh contact sheet and defines the NEW design; use its down row for outfit/palette and its up row only for facing direction. Image 2 is the approved NEW down idle frame and defines exact body size, colors, hood, scarf, boots and pixel finish. Image 3 is the approved NEW down lantern-off idle frame and defines the unlit hands and outfit.
Scene/backdrop: no scene, genuinely transparent background; no floor or shadows.
Subject: the same small hooded adventurer in all cells, back facing, with cream/tan hood and short cloak, red scarf, dark brown boots and small utility details. For this unlit sheet, Nhinh carries nothing: both hands are empty, and there is no lantern, flame, glow, spark, or light source in any pose. Preserve character proportions across all seven poses.
Style/medium: clean hand-authored-looking pixel art with crisp square pixel edges and restrained clusters, matching the NEW character shown in references. No antialiasing, blur, gradients or text.
Composition/framing: landscape sprite atlas; exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, generous transparent padding between cells, each sprite upright and fully visible, 36:42 character-cell proportions. Top row static idle then three clearly distinct walking phases; bottom row three clearly distinct running phases. Walking and running poses should loop smoothly through different leg/arm placements and slight body bob without changing facing or size. Leave the eighth cell fully transparent.
Lighting/mood: even neutral sprite shading, no external light effects.
Color palette: match references: warm ivory/cream cloth, muted sand and peach skin/shadow pixels, deep rust-red scarf, dark espresso brown boots and outlines.
Constraints: transparent alpha; exactly seven sprites; no sprite touches a cell boundary; feet rest on a common baseline; maintain crisp pixel scale and matching appearance; use references only for design guidance.
Avoid: any other characters, backgrounds, tile grids/lines, borders, captions, labels, logos, watermark, duplicate sprites, extra props, alternate costume, any lantern or handheld item, glow, sparks, or stray opaque pixels in the empty eighth cell.
